name: Jerusalem
note: City of David, of the temple, and of the passion.

name: Bethlehem
note: Town of Judah, home of David and birthplace of Jesus.

name: Nazareth
note: The Galilean town where Jesus grew up.

name: Capernaum
note: Lakeside town where Jesus taught and healed.

name: Sea of Galilee
note: The freshwater lake, and the region around it.

name: Jordan
note: The river Israel crossed, and where Jesus was baptized.

name: Jericho
note: The city of palms in the Jordan valley.

name: Dead Sea
note: The salt sea at the end of the Jordan.

name: Hebron
note: Abraham's burial place, and David's first capital.

name: Beersheba
note: The southern well of the patriarchs.

name: Gaza
note: A Philistine city on the coast, later on the road south.

name: Joppa
note: The port where Jonah sailed, and where Peter stayed.

name: Caesarea
note: Herod's port, where Peter met Cornelius.

name: Samaria
note: Capital of the northern kingdom, and the region around it.

name: Shechem
note: The pass between Ebal and Gerizim.

name: Bethel
note: Where Jacob dreamed of the ladder.

name: Shiloh
note: The first resting place of the tabernacle.

name: Gilgal
note: The camp after Israel crossed the Jordan.

name: Ai
note: The town east of Bethel that Joshua took.

name: Emmaus
note: A village on the road where the risen Jesus was recognized. The exact site is debated.

name: Bethany
note: The village of Martha, Mary, and Lazarus, on the slope toward the Mount of Olives.

name: Mount of Olives
note: The ridge east of Jerusalem.

name: Gethsemane
note: The garden at the foot of the Mount of Olives.

name: Golgotha
note: The place of the skull. Marked at the traditional site of the Church of the Holy Sepulchre.

name: Mount Moriah
note: The hill of Abraham's offering, later the temple mount.

name: Zion
note: The stronghold David took, and a name for God's city.

name: Sodom
note: One of the cities of the plain. The site is not certain; tradition places it near the southern Dead Sea.

name: En Gedi
note: The spring and wilderness where David hid.

name: Megiddo
note: The fortress pass where Josiah fell, named again in Revelation.

name: Mount Carmel
note: The ridge where Elijah called down fire.

name: Cana
note: A Galilean village of the wedding feast. Marked at traditional Kafr Kanna.

name: Bethsaida
note: A fishing town at the north of the lake. The exact mound is debated.

name: Caesarea Philippi
note: The spring at the foot of Hermon where Peter confessed Christ.

name: Dan
note: The northern city, once Laish, at the headwaters of the Jordan.

name: Tyre
note: The island merchant city of Phoenicia.

name: Sidon
note: The Phoenician port north of Tyre.

name: Damascus
note: The ancient city where Saul was stopped on the road.

name: Antioch
note: The Syrian Antioch where the disciples were first called Christians.

name: Tarsus
note: Paul's home city in Cilicia.

name: Ephesus
note: The great city of Asia where Paul taught.

name: Smyrna
note: A church of Asia, on the Aegean coast.

name: Pergamum
note: A royal city of Asia, named among the seven churches.

name: Thyatira
note: Lydia's city, and one of the seven churches.

name: Sardis
note: The old capital of Lydia, named among the seven churches.

name: Philadelphia
note: A city of Asia named among the seven churches.

name: Laodicea
note: A wealthy city of the Lycus valley, named among the seven churches.

name: Corinth
note: The Greek city where Paul stayed and wrote.

name: Athens
note: Where Paul spoke on the Areopagus.

name: Thessalonica
note: The Macedonian city of the Thessalonian church.

name: Philippi
note: The Roman colony where Lydia and the jailer believed.

name: Berea
note: The Macedonian city that searched the Scriptures.

name: Rome
note: The capital where Paul arrived in chains.

name: Malta
note: The island where Paul's ship was wrecked.

name: Crete
note: The island Paul sailed past, and where Titus worked.

name: Cyprus
note: The island of Barnabas, and Paul's first voyage.

name: Alexandria
note: The Egyptian port of Apollos and of the grain ships.

name: Egypt
note: The land of the Nile, marked here at the delta.

name: Sinai
note: The traditional mountain of the law. Horeb is often identified with it.

name: Babylon
note: The city on the Euphrates that took Judah into exile.

name: Ur
note: Abraham's city in the land of the Chaldeans.

name: Haran
note: The city where Abraham's family stayed before Canaan.

name: Nineveh
note: The great city of Assyria where Jonah preached.

name: Shushan
note: The palace city of Esther and Nehemiah.

name: Ararat
note: The mountains where the ark came to rest. A single peak is not identified.

name: Canaan
note: The land promised to Abraham, marked here in the central hills.

name: Moab
note: The plateau east of the Dead Sea.

name: Edom
note: The land of Esau, south of the Dead Sea.

name: Mount Nebo
note: The height in Moab where Moses looked into the land.

name: Patmos
note: The Aegean island where John received the Revelation.

name: Valley of Elah
note: The valley where David met Goliath.

name: Troas
note: The port where Paul saw the man of Macedonia, and later raised Eutychus.

name: Samothrace
note: The island Paul passed on the sail from Troas toward Macedonia.

name: Neapolis
note: The port for Philippi, where Paul landed in Macedonia.

name: Iconium
note: A city of Galatia where Paul and Barnabas preached and were driven out.

name: Lystra
note: Timothy's city. Here the crowd honored Paul, then stoned him.

name: Derbe
note: The last city of the first journey before they turned back. The mound is the traditional site.

name: Paphos
note: The western city of Cyprus, where the proconsul believed.

name: Salamis
note: The eastern city of Cyprus, where they began to preach in the synagogues.

name: Pisidian Antioch
note: A Roman colony in the highlands, not the Antioch in Syria. Paul preached in the synagogue here.

name: Perga
note: A city of Pamphylia where John Mark left Paul and Barnabas.

name: Attalia
note: The port they sailed from on the way back to Syrian Antioch.

name: Seleucia
note: The port of Syrian Antioch, where the first journey went on board.

name: Myra
note: The Lycian port where Paul changed ships for Italy.

name: Cnidus
note: A cape they reached slowly, sailing into the wind.

name: Fair Havens
note: A bay on the south of Crete, near Lasea, where Paul urged them to winter.

name: Clauda
note: The small island under whose lee they secured the boat.

name: Syracuse
note: The Sicilian port where the ship stayed three days.

name: Rhegium
note: The harbor at the toe of Italy, where they waited for a south wind.

name: Puteoli
note: The Italian port where Paul found believers and stayed seven days.

name: Appii Forum
note: A station on the Appian Way where believers from Rome met Paul. The marker is the traditional stretch of that road.

name: Three Taverns
note: Another station on the way to Rome where the brethren met him.

name: Cenchrea
note: The eastern port of Corinth, and Phoebe's church.

name: Miletus
note: Where Paul called the elders of Ephesus and prayed with them on the beach.

name: Assos
note: Paul went here on foot while the ship sailed around the cape.

name: Mitylene
note: The harbor of Lesbos, the night after Assos.

name: Chios
note: An island they came over against on the sail south.

name: Samos
note: The island they reached the day after Chios.

name: Cos
note: The first island on the run from Miletus toward Tyre.

name: Rhodes
note: The island after Cos, on the way to Patara.

name: Patara
note: The Lycian port where they found a ship crossing to Phoenicia.

name: Ptolemais
note: A Phoenician port where they greeted the believers and stayed one day.

name: Kadesh
note: The wilderness camp of the spies and of Moses' striking the rock. Marked at the traditional oasis; the text does not fix a modern map point.

name: Colossae
note: A city of the Lycus valley. Paul wrote to the church there, and to Philemon.

name: Hierapolis
note: A city near Colossae and Laodicea, named in the greetings.

name: Galatia
note: A region of central Asia Minor, not one city. The letter is to the churches there.
